name: Ikejiri Subaru
source:
[url=/c40520]Chizuru[/url]'s daughter.  A kouhai to Kyouko Sakura when they went to an all girls' school.

Upon learning the protagonist is the husband of Kyouko, her idolized senpai, this little devil bombards him daily with verbal abuse and cat punches while shoving divorce papers in his face.

Yet, whenever Kyouko is present, she becomes as docile as a kitten.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106141&gc=gc] Getchu[/url]]
